transport: Local WebSocket link through HDC, not physical NearLink
procedure: Live UI and SDK log checks, with assertions against the saved native evidence. B stale HDC socket was explicitly disconnected after reinstall before reconnect.

results.name: Three independent native clients registered; initial topology AB only
Lost ACK causes one retry; B accepts once and recognizes the duplicate
Isolated C has no alert and no packet route
After B app process restart, saved signatures are reverified with A disconnected
B forwards its restored alert to C over BC; C verifies hop 2 without A
Tampered and expired packets are rejected without ACK or forwarding
Valid saved alert remains unchanged after both invalid injections
Explicit duplicate is ACKed again without forwarding to C

limitations: No physical radio, range, battery or background-delivery measurements
